product.tagline: 把多项目开发上下文收进一个可执行、可复核的本地工作台。
product.description: 围绕工作区、项目、资源入口、Git、构建、本地代理、运行时和活动记录，统一组织开发动作，并向 CLI 与 AI Agent 暴露稳定的机器接口。
nonGoals: 替代 GitLab、Jenkins 或现有 CI/CD 平台
托管团队密钥、远端凭据或业务源代码
在没有计划和确认的情况下执行高风险发布动作

facts.label: 数据边界
facts.value: 本地配置与 SQLite 状态

capabilities.title: 工作区上下文
capabilities.body: 以 system 全局视图和需求工作区组织项目、入口、代理、实例目录与当前开发范围。

capabilities.title: 资源与项目入口
capabilities.body: 集中搜索项目、网站、目录、应用和脚本，并保留收藏、最近使用和工作区过滤。

capabilities.title: Git 工作流
capabilities.body: 覆盖分支同步、创建、检出、切换、合并预览、推送检查和多项目任务。

capabilities.title: 构建与运行时
capabilities.body: 统一规划 Jenkins、本地命令和 R 系列打包任务，并监督项目运行时、日志与产物。

capabilities.title: 代理与联调链
capabilities.body: 组合本地代理、Mock、转发、Runtime 生命周期和页面聚焦，形成可检查的 Link。

capabilities.title: 活动与 Agent 接口
capabilities.body: 把 App、CLI 和托盘动作汇总为统一台账，保留状态、证据、风险和安全重放入口。

workflow.label: 进入
workflow.title: 选择当前工作区
workflow.body: 先确定需求或系统上下文，只加载当前范围内的项目、入口、代理和实例。

workflow.label: 检查
workflow.title: 读取事实与运行状态
workflow.body: 查看分支、构建目标、Runtime 观测、配置来源和受管产物，再决定下一步动作。

workflow.label: 执行
workflow.title: 先计划，再运行
workflow.body: 构建、Git、Link 与高风险操作先生成计划和风险说明，通过确认后再执行。

workflow.label: 复盘
workflow.title: 记录结果并安全重放
workflow.body: 活动中心统一保留执行来源、状态、详情、历史关联和可重放动作。

boundary.title: 开发事实留在本机，外部系统保持原有职责
boundary.body: rDevTool 只保存本地配置、工作区引用和机器状态，不替代 GitLab、Jenkins 或 CI/CD。凭据通过环境变量或私有配置提供，写入、推送、构建和发布动作保持可见并优先预检。

website.releaseSummary: 当前预览版本已覆盖工作区、资源入口、Git、构建、代理、Link、Runtime、受管产物、统一活动台账、托盘和 AI 友好 CLI。

product.tagline: Bring multi-project development context into one executable, reviewable local workbench.
product.description: Organize workspaces, projects, resources, Git, builds, local proxies, runtimes, and activity history in one place, with stable machine interfaces for the CLI and AI agents.
nonGoals: Replace GitLab, Jenkins, or an existing CI/CD platform
Host team secrets, remote credentials, or business source code
Run high-risk release actions without a visible plan and confirmation

capabilities.title: Workspace context
capabilities.body: Use the global system view or a scoped requirement workspace to organize projects, resources, proxies, managed instances, and the current development boundary.

capabilities.title: Resources and project entry points
capabilities.body: Search projects, websites, directories, apps, and scripts while preserving favorites, recents, and workspace filtering.

capabilities.title: Git workflows
capabilities.body: Inspect branch state, sync targets, create or switch branches, preview merges, check push status, and run multi-project tasks.

capabilities.title: Builds and runtimes
capabilities.body: Plan Jenkins, local-command, and R Series package builds while supervising project runtimes, logs, readiness, and managed artifacts.

capabilities.title: Proxy and debugging chains
capabilities.body: Compose local proxies, mocks, forwarding rules, runtime lifecycles, and page focus into inspectable Link workflows.

capabilities.title: Activity and agent interfaces
capabilities.body: Unify desktop, CLI, and tray activity with status, evidence, risk details, and guarded replay through deterministic JSON commands.

workflow.label: Enter
workflow.title: Choose the current workspace
workflow.body: Start with the requirement or system context and load only the projects, resources, proxies, and instances relevant to that scope.

workflow.label: Inspect
workflow.title: Read facts and runtime state
workflow.body: Review branches, build targets, runtime observations, configuration sources, and managed artifacts before choosing an action.

workflow.label: Execute
workflow.title: Plan first, then run
workflow.body: Build, Git, Link, and other consequential operations expose a plan and risk summary before execution.

workflow.label: Review
workflow.title: Record results and replay safely
workflow.body: The activity center keeps origin, status, details, history relationships, and only the actions that can be replayed safely.

boundary.title: Development facts stay local while external systems keep their responsibilities
boundary.body: rDevTool stores local configuration, workspace references, and machine state. It does not replace GitLab, Jenkins, or CI/CD. Credentials come from environment variables or private local configuration, and writes, pushes, builds, and releases remain visible and previewable.

website.releaseSummary: The current preview covers workspaces, resource entry points, Git, builds, proxies, Links, runtimes, managed artifacts, unified activity history, the system tray, and an agent-friendly CLI.

documentation.label: Product and usage overview
documentation.description: Purpose, main work areas, quick start, CLI, local data, privacy, and development commands.

documentation.label: Release and packaging
documentation.description: Desktop build targets, preview release workflow, artifact evidence, and signing status.

documentation.label: Changelog
documentation.description: Features, fixes, security, and documentation changes by version.

cli.highRiskPolicy: 构建、部署、合并、推送、工作区复制和配置写入优先执行 plan、overview、status 或 dry-run，再由用户确认。

runtime.secretPolicy: 敏感信息使用环境变量、系统凭据或不入库的私有本地配置，不应进入仓库模板、一次性命令参数和机器可读诊断。
